hero.eyebrow: Design and technology studio · Buenos Aires
hero.texto: We're a design and technology studio in Buenos Aires. We help growing businesses automate processes, add AI agents and get systems and websites that are easy to use.

manifiesto.texto: It's not about adding a chatbot. It's about finding where time gets lost, automating it well and making sure the people who use it barely notice. That's what we design.

items.texto: We find the tasks your team repeats every day and make them run on their own: data entry, notifications, reports, follow-ups. We connect the tools you already use so nobody copies data by hand.
Agents that answer questions, sort orders and reply over WhatsApp or email, and only hand a person what really needs one. They work with your business's own information, not generic answers.
Dashboards, internal platforms and management tools built around how your team works, not the other way around.
Websites and apps designed and built end to end, easy to understand and connected to the rest of your operation.
When it's needed, we also design the identity: name, logo and visual system.

preguntas.bajada: If your question isn't here, write to us and you'll get an answer from us, not a bot.

items.q: Which processes in my business can be automated?
items.a: Almost anything that's done by hand and repeated today: moving data from one system to another, sending reminders and notifications, putting reports together, following up on clients or orders. We start by looking at how your team works and tell you where you'll save the most time.

items.q: What is an AI agent and what can it do for me?
items.a: It's a program that understands what people write to it and works with your business's information: it answers questions, takes orders, books appointments or looks up data in your system. We build it for a specific task and, when something falls outside what's expected, it hands it to someone on your team.

items.q: Do I have to change the tools I already use?
items.a: No. We usually connect what you already have (spreadsheets, your management system, WhatsApp, email) so data moves from one place to the other on its own. If a tool is holding you back, we'll tell you and decide together whether it's worth changing.

items.q: Can you help me build a system for my business?
items.a: Yes. We design and build custom dashboards and platforms: first we understand how your team works and then we build the system around it, in stages, so you can start using it as soon as possible.

items.q: How much does it cost to work with you?
items.a: It depends on the scope. After a first conversation we send you a fixed quote, with what each stage includes and how long it takes. No surprises halfway through.

items.q: I have a website but I don't like it. Could you redesign it?
items.a: Yes. We look at what works and what doesn't, and redesign it so it's easy to understand, loads fast and connects to the rest of your operation: forms, WhatsApp or your system.

clientes.titulo: We work with people who dare.
clientes.bajada: From projects starting from scratch to brands with twenty years of history. Each one pushes us not to repeat ourselves.

meta.titulo: Gemmia Logistics: bilingual brand and website — Wapi
meta.descripcion: Bilingual brand and website for Gemmia Logistics, which moves cargo between Latin America and the world: a faceted gem that is also a package in transit.

casos.bajada: We created the brand and website for a company that moves cargo between Latin America and the world: a faceted gem that is also a package in transit.
casos.imagenAlt: Gemmia Logistics logo: the faceted hexagonal gem next to the name.

partida.titulo: A new company that needed to look as reliable as its team.
partida.texto: Gemmia was born with a team that has more than 15 years of experience moving cargo by air, sea and land to more than 180 countries. But it was competing against global giants without a brand or a website of its own. It needed an identity that showed that experience from day one, in two languages and three markets.

pasos.texto: We understood the business before drawing anything: what a freight forwarder does, which industries it serves and why its edge is a dedicated point of contact who follows every shipment.
We created the faceted hexagonal gem (value, precision and a package in transit), the two-blue palette and the Soleil typeface. Every step was decided by looking, not by reading reports.
We published the bilingual website with an online quote tool and delivered a 22-page brand guide so the team can apply the identity without depending on anyone.

figuras.pie: The website, in English and Spanish: quotes answered in under 2 hours.

figuras.pie: The real stationery: letterhead, envelopes and business cards with the facets of the gem.

resultados.texto: a complete brand ready to operate in three markets at once.
languages: the same website speaks to Latin America and the United States.

meta.titulo: Credigial: a platform for a lender — Wapi
meta.descripcion: The platform a lender used to leave spreadsheets behind and bring order to clients, loans, collections and cash: four modules, one system.

casos.bajada: Four modules, one system: the platform a lender used to leave spreadsheets behind and bring order to clients, loans, collections and cash.
casos.imagenAlt: Demo of the flow: creating a loan from the list, filling in the form and returning with the success message

partida.titulo: The whole operation lived in spreadsheets, and they had already lost data once.
partida.texto: Clients, loans, collections and cash were tracked in separate files, on a single computer. The company had already suffered a data loss and had to rebuild its records by hand. The challenge wasn't digitizing a process: it was designing a product reliable enough to carry the day-to-day operation.

pasos.texto: Before drawing a single screen, we understood how the operation worked. The spreadsheets were our discovery document: we mapped how clients, loans, collections and cash related to each other.

Module by module, with forms that ask for just enough: adding a client takes four fields. Granting a loan, on the other hand, has its own screen, because it's the most important decision in the operation.
We worked with a kit shared between design and development (every designed component already existed in code under the same name) and reviewed the built product against the design, screen by screen.

figuras.alt: Credigial clients screen: the table with the search bar.
figuras.pie: The clients table does one thing well: find someone and open their record.

figuras.alt: Credigial new loan screen, with the financial summary on the side.
figuras.pie: Creating a loan takes the full screen: amounts, installments and interest without distractions.

figuras.alt: Confirmation to cancel a loan in Credigial.
figuras.pie: Every action asks for confirmation, every mistake can be undone: confidence for someone who already lost their data once.

resultados.texto: modules designed, delivered and checked against the real product.
spreadsheets: the operation no longer depends on a file on a single machine.
fields are enough to add a client. Everything else, only when needed.

cita.texto: “The team stopped seeing it as a tool and started treating it as their product.”

meta.titulo: Ida & Vuelta Ibiza: brand and booking website — Wapi
meta.descripcion: Brand and website with WhatsApp bookings for Ida & Vuelta Ibiza, a family holiday rental concierge that started from scratch on the island.

casos.bajada: A family that has hosted guests in Ibiza for more than ten years started its own business. We designed and built the brand and website it launched on the island with.
casos.imagenAlt: A tour of the Ida & Vuelta Ibiza website: home, about us, how to book and a house page

partida.titulo: There was nothing to redesign: the business was starting from scratch.
partida.texto: The family already had the houses, the years on the island and the guests. What it didn't have was a name of its own, a brand, or a place to show the properties. Everything in this case was defined from scratch, with one condition: the website couldn't replace the personal attention, because that's the one thing nobody can copy.

pasos.texto: We understood how they take care of guests before drawing anything: they answer themselves, know every cove and stay with guests through the whole trip. That back-and-forth with each guest ended up giving the brand its name.

An island identity without the tourist postcard: harbor blue, terracotta and Spectral for the headings. And a website where the search asks for two things, the area and how many people are traveling, because the rest gets talked through later.
We built and published the website: the houses on the map, each page with photos, location and price, and a booking that ends in a WhatsApp chat instead of a form.

figuras.pie: The brand: the name tells how they take care of guests, and the visual system goes along without falling into the tourist postcard.

figuras.pie: About us: a family with more than ten years on the island, told in its own voice.

meta.titulo: Zuhause: the brand of a gym in Lanús — Wapi
meta.descripcion: The brand of Zuhause, a gym in Lanús that now also signs clothes, objects and videos: wordmark, symbol, storefront, apparel and website.

casos.bajada: It started as the brand of a gym in Lanús and now it also signs the clothes, objects and videos of its community.
casos.imagenAlt: The Zuhause storefront in Lanús, with the logo and the symbol.

partida.titulo: A serious gym that wanted to feel like being at home.
partida.texto: Zuhause means «at home» in German, and that was the brief: a serious training space, with top-level machines and coaches, but where people stay to chat after their workout. The brand had to work on a storefront, on a T-shirt and on a neon sign, and be ready for whatever the community asked of it next.

pasos.texto: We understood what makes the place different: coaches who know every member, a team that shows up in every photo and a community that feels part of it.
A lowercase wordmark and a three-stroke symbol in motion, made to read on the storefront as well as printed on a T-shirt. Black, violet and a yellow that only shows up when needed.
We took the brand where it lives: the storefront, the training room wall, the apparel and the website. Today we're designing the system the gym will use to manage members, cash and sales.

meta.titulo: Gymrat: membership fees over WhatsApp — Wapi
meta.descripcion: A dashboard on the computer and the phone so a gym collects fees without chasing anyone: WhatsApp reminders go out on their own.

casos.bajada: A dashboard, on the computer and on the phone, so a gym can collect membership fees without chasing anyone: WhatsApp reminders go out on their own from the 1st to the 10th of every month.
casos.imagenAlt: The Gymrat dashboard on the computer and on the phone, with what was collected and what's still due.

partida.titulo: Collecting fees meant messaging every member, one by one.
partida.texto: Every month, from the 1st to the 10th, the owner sent each member a message reminding them to pay. He wanted those reminders to go out on their own over WhatsApp, without losing control: being able to change the text, add new members and stop messaging people who no longer needed it.

pasos.texto: We understood how he collected: what he said in each message, who he wrote to and what happened when someone had already paid or had left the gym.
A dashboard with four sections: Home, Fees, Members and Settings, that works the same on the computer and on the phone. The message is edited with a preview of how it reaches the member.
We set up the WhatsApp account so reminders go out automatically and handed the full design over to development, flow by flow and in both versions.

figuras.alt: Gymrat Settings screen: the WhatsApp message and its preview.
figuras.pie: The message is edited in the dashboard, with a preview of how it reaches the member right next to it. Changes go out with the next reminder.

figuras.alt: Gymrat Members screen, with the list and the button to add a new one.
figuras.pie: Members: adding someone new or deactivating them takes a couple of taps. The crossed-out bell marks who doesn't get reminders.

figuras.alt: Gymrat sent reminders screen, with the status of each one.
figuras.pie: Every reminder is logged: whether it arrived, whether it was cancelled or whether the number had no WhatsApp.

figuras.alt: Three screens of the Gymrat dashboard on the phone.
figuras.pie: The same dashboard on the phone, to collect and check from the front desk.

resultados.texto: the days of each month when reminders go out on their own, with no typing by hand.
one-by-one messages: the text is changed in the dashboard and goes out with the next reminder.

meta.descripcion: What data the Wapi website collects, what we use it for, where it is kept and how to ask us to correct or delete it.

privacidad.intro: What data this website collects, what we use it for and what you can ask us about it.

parrafos: Wapi, a design and technology studio in Buenos Aires, Argentina. For any question about your data, write to info@wapidesign.com.
Only what you send us through the contact form: your name, your email, your company name if you add it and your message. You don't need to give us any data to browse the site.
To answer your inquiry and, if we move forward, to talk about the project. We don't use it to send you advertising and we don't share it with anyone.

secciones.titulo: Where it is kept and for how long
parrafos: Your message reaches us by email at info@wapidesign.com and stays in that inbox. We don't store it in any database. We send you a confirmation to the email you gave us.

To stop automated submissions we count how many messages come from the same connection and the same email, without storing either in readable form. That count deletes itself within a few days. The form's technical logs don't include your data and are deleted after 30 days.
The website and the emails run on Amazon Web Services, and our mailbox on Microsoft 365. Both may process data outside Argentina, under their own security measures.

The website doesn't use cookies or any analytics or advertising tools. It only stores in your browser the language you chose and whether you've already seen the intro animation. You can clear it from your browser settings.
You can ask us to see, correct or delete your data by writing to info@wapidesign.com.

Under Argentine Law No. 25,326 on Personal Data Protection, you may access your personal data free of charge at intervals of no less than six months, unless a legitimate interest is shown (section 14, subsection 3).

The Agencia de Acceso a la Información Pública, as the enforcement authority of Law No. 25,326, handles complaints from anyone whose rights have been affected by a breach of personal data protection rules.
If we change any of this, we'll update this page with the date.
